university: Rutgers, The State University of New Jersey - New Brunswick
department_or_school: Department of Nutritional Sciences, School of Environmental and Biological Sciences (SEBS); School of Graduate Studies
spring_2027_deadline: Not verified - program pages list only fall guidance; page says applications accepted 'at any time' but no spring intake is described
fall_2027_deadline: Recurring rule: apply by January 1 if seeking financial assistance; no later than February 15 for fall admission (2027-specific date not separately posted)
funding_deadline_note: January 1 advised for doctoral applicants seeking financial assistance
ielts_subscore_note: School of Graduate Studies-New Brunswick: 'minimum IELTS score is bandwidth 7'; some programs may set stricter requirements; English-test waiver possible case-by-case if bachelor's was taught in English; test must be within two years of enrollment. (Rutgers undergraduate admissions page lists 6.5 for New Brunswick - that is not the graduate rule.)
toefl_min: School of Graduate Studies section minimums: tests taken before 2026-01-22 - Writing 22, Speaking 23, Reading 21, Listening 17; tests from 2026-01-22 (new score scale) - section minimums listed as 4.5, 4.5, 4 and 4 (confirm section order on page). Duolingo minimum 120. NSGP apply page separately lists 550 PBT / 213 CBT / 110 iBT (appears outdated).
funding_summary: Program pages: doctoral students are typically supported by assistantships/fellowships that include stipend, health insurance and full tuition remission. Handbook: the research advisor will need to help find funding for stipend, tuition and research; doctoral applicants should discuss funding with potential research advisors; some of the 50+ faculty may not be able to take a new student in a given year.
notes: Advisor contact is recommended by the handbook, not a formal requirement. IELTS 7.0 minimum is ABOVE the applicant's 6.5 - she would need a retake or a waiver. Program contacts seen in search-result text of nutrition.rutgers.edu pages (confirm before use; useful for asking whether a spring start is possible): graduate co-directors Carol Byrd-Bredbenner (bredbenner@sebs.rutgers.edu) and Tracy Anthony (tracy.anthony@rutgers.edu); coordinator Nicole Martinez (nmartinez@sebs.rutgers.edu). Transcripts from outside US/Canada/UK/NZ/Australia should be evaluated by WES per apply page. Context: Rutgers Food Science (a different program) lists a spring deadline of June 15 of the prior year - already passed for Spring 2027.
